text.tspan: Sextant corrections
Lunar corrections
* Inner index to minutes of sextant height Ho on outer
* Pointer to Index Eror (red for negative) on inner
* Sun Lower limb:
- Inner to align month with pointer
- Rotate pointer clockwise to inner index
* Sun Upper limb:
- Inner index to align with pointer
- Poniter counter clockwise to align with month
* Moon:
- Inner index to align with pointer
- Pointer to clockwise semidiameter for lower,
counterclockwise to red semidiameter for upper
* Rotate inner to align height of eye with pointer
* Rotate pointer counter clockwise to sextant angle
and temperature curve
* Read minutes of Hs from outer ring, be sure to carry
Declination:
* Align inner index with minutes of noon declination
* +d: rotate pointer to black time of observation
* -d: rotate pointer to red time of observation
Latitude from Noon Sight:
* Zenith angle 90 - Ho: read red minutes from outer
subtract whole degrees
* Facing south: Latitude = Declination + 90 - Ho
* Facing north: Latitude = Declination - 90 + Ho
Lunar semidiameter
* Align pointer and outer index
* Rotate inner to align latitude of observation
for semi-diameter augmentation (adds to SD)
* Rotate pointer to red Lunar semi-diameter crossing
the HP curve
* Read minutes of semi-diameter from outer black
* Should be in the range 14.5' - 17.1'
Lunar parallax
* Align inner and outer index
* Rotate pointer to intersection of sextant height
and HP curve.
* Read minutes of parallax from outer black ring
* Can be greater than 60' for very low angles
* Always adds to the height of the moon
Time from lunar distance
* Correct lunar distance with triangle method
* Consult almanac for lunar distance at start and end
of the hour around the observed time
* Use Red on the outer ring if the difference is negative
* Align inner index with minutes of start of the hour
* Rotate pointer to minutes of the next hour
* Observe crossing curve; should match the difference
* Rotate the pointer to the minutes of the lunar distance
* Follow the crossing curve to the time past the hour
